description: This PHP class defines the entity RegistrationEventQueue, which maps to the database table 'ohrm_registration_event_queue'. It manages registration event queue entries, including properties like event type, timestamps, publication status, and data payload, and provides getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueue
classes.description: Entity class representing registration event queue entries with properties for event details, publishing status, and timestamps, including constants for event types and batch sizes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the registration event queue entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the registration event queue entry.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the registration event.

methods.name: setEventType
methods.description: Sets the type of the registration event.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the event has been published.

methods.name: setPublished
methods.description: Sets the publication status of the event.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the event occurred.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the event occurred.

methods.name: getPublishTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the event was published.

methods.name: setPublishTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the event was published.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data payload associated with the event.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data payload for the event.
